name: Book Nook
summary: An independent bookshop with a drawn shelf you take books from, Urdu editions, samples and gift wrap
about: A multi-page shop for an independent bookshop in Islamabad, in paper, ink blue and warm red. Books stand on a drawn shelf: hover a spine and the book slides off, turns from spine to cover in mid-air and lands in a drawn hand. Every book opens to a look inside sample with page turns, and the bag wraps the first book in the paper and ribbon you choose, fold by fold. There are staff picks, pre-orders with countdowns, a reading club with progress and a vote, gift cards, checkout in PKR and order tracking.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Browse, Staff picks, Pre-orders, Reading club, Gift cards, the wishlist, your account or the bag
Hover a spine on the home shelf, or switch Browse to Shelf view, and the book slides off into the hand; on a phone, tap a spine
Filter by genre, language, translation, format and price, open a book, pick an edition and press Look inside to turn the sample pages
Reserve pre-orders, save a seat and log your page in the reading club, and design a gift card with a live preview
In the bag, switch on gift wrap and watch the paper fold round the book; choose the paper, the ribbon and the tag
Check out with cash on delivery, bank transfer or the demo card, then follow the parcel on the track page
Press Ctrl+K to search everything; reset demo data in Account settings
